mods.description: A highly customizable Bongo Cat overlay for Minecraft.

releases.notes:
# 🐾 BongoHUD (Bonjo Cat)

Bring the legendary Bongo Cat to your Minecraft HUD! **BongoHUD** is a performance-oriented Fabric mod that translates your real-time inputs into reactive animations.

## ✨ Features
* **Dynamic Input Tracking:** Paws react instantly to keys and mouse clicks.
* **Built-in HUD Editor:** Click and drag the cat anywhere on your screen.
* **Mod Menu Support:** Easy in-game configuration.
* **Deep Customization:** Swap skins and adjust animation speed.

## 🛠️ Requirements
* [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
* [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
* [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)

## 🤝 Contributing
Pull requests are welcome! Open an issue first to discuss major changes.

## Works well on 1.21+
